content.text: [Email angela_reyes → regulatory_team Wed Mar 30 08:00 EST 2026] Subject: Ivenix LVP Recall — Z-0885-2026 Initial Assessment. Team — I've reviewed the SoftwareCPR posting on recall Z-0885-2026. Product code LVP-SW-0005. Initial email from our contact says the affected software version is 5.10.0. I'm also looking at distribution — one internal memo says Nimbus distribution started as early as 2014, but I'm not certain of the exact date. Can the RCA team verify both these data points?

Logged Angela's initial assessment. Two data points flagged for verification: (1) Ivenix affected version: 5.10.0 per initial contact — this may be incomplete, need to verify against official recall documentation; (2) Nimbus distribution start: Angela's memo says 2014, but the FDA official notice and MedTech Dive confirm 2015-02-27 — the 2014 reference appears to be an error. Will confirm with primary sources.

[Email kevin_liu → regulatory_team Wed Mar 30 09:30 EST 2026] Re: Ivenix software version — I've reviewed the Manufacturing Chemist article (https://manufacturingchemist.com/fda-class-i-recall-fresenius-kabi-ivenix-infusion). They clearly state software version 5.10.1 AND EARLIER are affected (product code LVP-SW-0005). The '5.10.0 only' statement from Angela's initial contact was incomplete. The correct statement should be '5.10.1 and earlier'. Also, AABB article confirms IMS update to 5.2.2 and LVP to 5.10.2. Battery replacement threshold: 70%.

Kevin confirms: affected version is 5.10.1 and earlier (not just 5.10.0). Both Manufacturing Chemist and AABB confirm this. Key corrections: affected_software_version = '5.10.1 and earlier'; fixed_version = 5.10.2; IMS fixed = 5.2.2; battery threshold = 70%. This will be applied when Update 1 is processed formally.
